step: H36 (after H33; the assembly head is rewired to it)

parameters.name: spec:params.strip_u
parameters.what: |u| from which the old front is stripped: above y .045, and below it (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:params.strip_y_blend
parameters.what: rows over which strip_u switches

parameters.name: spec:params.strip_ramp
parameters.what: width of the strip edge in u

parameters.name: spec:params.strip_bottom
parameters.what: no strip below this row

parameters.name: spec:params.strip_bias
parameters.what: the strip cuts this much (figure heights) behind the mid-surface

parameters.name: spec:params.mid_blur
parameters.what: box blur of the fan mid-surface (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:params.core_inset
parameters.what: core outline inset from the closed sheet outline (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:params.core_depth
parameters.what: core front lies this far behind the coat plan front

parameters.name: spec:params.core_valley
parameters.what: the core front drops back this much (figure heights) away from the clumps

parameters.name: spec:params.valley_reach
parameters.what: valley_reach

parameters.name: spec:params.core_back
parameters.what: core rear lies this far in front of the old rear face

parameters.name: spec:params.core_blend
parameters.what: core to skin smooth union

parameters.name: spec:params.layer_blend
parameters.what: within layer 1, within layer 2, layer 2 onto layer 1 (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:params.s_length
parameters.what: secondaries (S) are this fraction of their table length (their tips then hide behind the primaries)

parameters.name: spec:params.s_back
parameters.what: secondaries (S) lie this much further back than their table front (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:params.skull_ramp
parameters.what: the cup carve runs this far into the skull side and meets the old front surface

parameters.name: spec:params.section_p
parameters.what: superellipse exponent of the clump section (2.2 = spec)

parameters.name: spec:params.blur
parameters.what: box blur radius in voxels of each clump field

parameters.name: spec:params.samples
parameters.what: axis samples per clump

parameters.name: spec:params.tip_half_width
parameters.what: floor of the half width near a tip; wider tips cost R03.2 fit and raise seam needles

parameters.name: spec:params.tip_half_thick
parameters.what: floor of the half thickness near a tip

parameters.name: spec:params.rear_margin
parameters.what: thickness clamp margin before the old rear face

parameters.name: spec:params.camber
parameters.what: forward camber of the clump front at mid length

parameters.name: spec:params.width_scale
parameters.what: multiplies every coat clump width (spec 1.0; round 18 used .9)

parameters.name: spec:params.lower_scale
parameters.what: width and thickness scale of the small lower locks (tip row .17 or lower), which are pins at table size

parameters.name: spec:params.thick_taper_scale
parameters.what: multiplies the thickness fall exponent

parameters.name: spec:params.taper_scale
parameters.what: multiplies the width taper exponents (below 1 = fuller, blunter points)

parameters.name: spec:params.thick_scale
parameters.what: multiplies every coat clump thickness

parameters.name: spec:params.length_scale
parameters.what: multiplies clump length, only for tip rows at or below pull_from_y

parameters.name: spec:params.top_lift
parameters.what: top-edge tips stand this much higher

parameters.name: spec:params.pull_from_y
parameters.what: length_scale applies only to clumps whose tip row is at least this (the table pushes the lower edge tips out)

parameters.name: spec:params.root_cap
parameters.what: how far a clump is carried behind its root

parameters.name: spec:params.cup_shift
parameters.what: moves the cup polygon in x

parameters.name: spec:params.cup_fillet
parameters.what: rim fillet radius

parameters.name: spec:params.floor_slope
parameters.what: cup floor slope in df per u; .70 is the 35 degree yaw

parameters.name: spec:params.floor_start
parameters.what: cup floor df at u .100

parameters.name: spec:params.floor_max
parameters.what: deepest cup floor df

parameters.name: spec:params.floor_bowl
parameters.what: extra concave depth toward the polygon middle

parameters.name: spec:params.tuft_blend
parameters.what: tuft clump to clump smooth union

parameters.name: spec:params.tuft_floor_blend
parameters.what: tuft to floor smooth union

parameters.name: spec:params.tuft_tip_half_width
parameters.what: tuft clumps use this tip floor (figure heights) instead of tip_half_width; None = same

parameters.name: spec:params.tuft_scale
parameters.what: tuft thickness scale

parameters.name: spec:params.tuft_width_scale
parameters.what: tuft width scale

parameters.name: spec:params.skip
parameters.what: comma list of clump names or families to drop

parameters.name: spec:params.rear_clip
parameters.what: new clump and tuft material is cut off this far behind the old rear face (negative = in front); keeps the rear fan (R04) unchanged

parameters.name: spec:cups.L / spec:cups.R
parameters.what: cup polygons in the fit frame; move with the face if R01 or R02 recenters it

parameters.name: spec:clumps.<name or pattern>
parameters.what: per-clump edits of the table rows (root, tip, curl, widthRoot, widthMid, thick, taper, layer), e.g. spec:clumps.LP5.widthMid=.05 or spec:clumps.*S.thick=.02

parameters.name: spec:pale.tol / gray / smooth
parameters.what: pale tuft material: face distance to a tuft field, base colour, majority-vote passes

parameters.name: spec:voxel
parameters.what: field grid size (head-local)

parameters.name: --front-table
parameters.what: clump table (loop/r03_clump_table.py makes it from specs/R03.md section 2); a table edit is a new file passed with recipe.py set

parameters.name: --envelope
parameters.what: sheet fan outline signed distance fields (loop/r03_envelope.py)

notes: The tool already existed as the round 18 builder's WIP (author_fan_clumps_field.py --part front, fan_clumps_front.py, fan_clumps_front_run.py, specs/r03_clumps.json, r03_envelope.npz, loop/r03_*.py; head-2114 was its last build). All of it is reused. Added: --spec JSON (params, cups, per-clump edits, pale, voxel) so recipe.py set and sweep reach every lever as spec:<path>; a rear_clip parameter that cuts new material off at the old rear face (containment max .0054 to .0033 before the zone fix); the interface in the fan_clumps_front_run.py docstring. Starter parameters are the round 18 builder's tuned values (strip_bias .008, s_length .85, s_back .008, skull_ramp .028, core_inset 0, width_scale .9, length_scale .95 below row .07, taper_scale .7, lower_scale 1.6 and 1.3), not the specs/R03.md numbers (core_inset .006, width_scale 1, length_scale 1), which are fan_clumps_front.DEFAULTS. R03.2 is the binding limit (spec friction 1). author_fan_clumps_field.py is also the R04 rear step's script, so its bytes changed again and the round 17 R04 step rebuilds under a new key. Quick and sweep compare against body-0448; the recipe cache maps B-23 to body-2118 (the assembled-2145 body).
